Where is your phone?

Extra option. The timer runs only while your phone lies face down. Picking it up pauses the timer and logs a distraction.

Silence and lock the phone itself

Fovea runs in the browser, so it cannot silence your phone or stop you leaving the app. Your phone can do both, and it puts everything back as it was when you switch them off. Menu names can differ a little between phones.

iPhone and iPad

  • Silence: open Control Centre, tap Focus, then Do Not Disturb. Tap the three dots beside it to choose "For 1 hour" so it ends by itself.
  • Lock to this app, set up once: Settings, Accessibility, Guided Access. Turn it on and set a passcode under Passcode Settings.
  • Each session: with Fovea open, triple-click the side button and tap Start. To leave, triple-click again and enter the passcode.

Android

  • Silence: swipe down from the top and tap Do Not Disturb. To have it end by itself, choose a length in Settings, Modes, Do Not Disturb, Duration for Quick Settings.
  • Lock to this app, set up once: Settings, Security, Advanced, App pinning. Turn it on.
  • Each session: open the recent apps view, tap Fovea's icon above its preview, and tap Pin. To leave, swipe up and hold, or hold Back and Overview, then enter your PIN.

      How the training works

      Five steps, from the daily practice to the weekly review.

      How the training works

      1. Do the daily practice. Five minutes of counting breaths. It trains the move every session depends on: noticing that your mind has drifted, and bringing it back.
      2. Make a plan before each session. Decide what you will do when the urge to stop comes, and put your phone out of reach.
      3. Hold a session and beat your unbroken stretch. That is the time you hold before anything pulls you away.
      4. Let the length grow. Three clean sessions in a row add 5 minutes. Two rough ones in a row take 5 minutes off, so the target stays within reach.
      5. Review the week. The Progress page shows what broke your focus and ends with one change to make next week.

      A clean session is one you finish as planned, with two or fewer distractions and a focus rating of 4 or 5. A rough one is ended early, has five or more distractions, or is rated 1 or 2. The real measure of progress is your unbroken stretch.

      The exercises take a few minutes each. Scores rise as you get used to each game, so treat them as a warm-up and a trend, not as proof of better focus.

      1

      Your climb

      The mountain, the zen-circle lake and the lotus, with your daily goal.

      Your climb

      How the climb works
      • The mountain. Each day you meet your daily goal lights the next of 30 stones on the trail. 30 goal days take you to the top, about a month.
      • The lake. At the top is a lake shaped like a zen circle. Here the climb gets harder: only days with a session of at least 1 hour count. Each one paints more of the circle, and 30 close it.
      • The lotus. A bud floats on the lake and opens as your day streak grows. It blooms at 100 days in a row, and every further 100 days adds a lotus. If the streak breaks, the bud starts again, but bloomed lotuses stay.

      Daily goal

      120 minutes is only a starting suggestion. Set the amount that suits you. Changes are kept in the log sheet below.

              Privacy notice
              
            
                
            This notice explains how Fovea (“we”, “us”) handles your information. Your sessions, plans, parked thoughts and settings are stored only on your device and are not transmitted to us.
            
                
            With your consent, we process the following through our secure online service: anonymous usage statistics, which are enabled by default and contain no name or contact details; your profile details (name, email address, age range, gender, focus aim and reported distractions), only where you choose to share them; and anonymous weekly focus totals, only where you opt in to comparison.
            
                
            If you turn on daily reminders, your device's notification address, time zone and chosen times are stored on our service so that the reminders can be sent. They contain no name or contact details, and turning reminders off deletes them.
            
                
            We use this information solely to operate and improve Fovea and, where you have permitted it, to contact you. We do not sell your information or use it for advertising. Other users see aggregated totals only and never information about an individual.
            
                
            Where a user is under 18, profile details are processed only with the consent of a parent or lawful guardian, in accordance with applicable law, including the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (India).
            
                
            You may withdraw your consent at any time by switching the relevant option off, whereupon the corresponding information is deleted from our records. To exercise your rights or raise a concern, please contact us through Send feedback in the Menu.

            Sound
            
            
            
            
            
            
            
            
            
            
            
            
            Focus and gamma beats need headphones: each ear hears a slightly different tone, and the brain hears the difference as a slow pulse. A few small studies found 16 Hz and 40 Hz beats helped attention; others found no effect, so treat them as an experiment.
            
            
            Choose None to keep a page silent. If you hear nothing, check your device's volume and silent mode.

            How to use
            Who Fovea is for, where the training takes you, the daily steps, features and answers.
            
              
            
            
            
            
              
            Step by step
            
          
            Everything a focus session involves, in order.
            
              
              
            
            1. Choose what to focus on. On the Focus page, type the task and pick a length. Tap a length or drag the ring.
              2. 
            
            2. Make your plan. Open Session options to pick a category, choose what you will do when the urge to stop comes, and say where your phone is. Out of reach is best.
              3. 
            
            3. Breathe first. Tap Start, read how the exercise works, then tap Begin breathing and follow the circle for about two minutes. You can skip it, or switch it off under Session options.
              4. 
            
            4. Stay with it. Once the timer starts, the screen shows only the timer, your plan and a box to park a nagging thought. Everything else is locked: press and hold anywhere for 5 seconds to log what pulled you away, pause or end. The controls lock again by themselves. Leaving the app or turning the screen off is logged as a distraction.
              5. 
            
            5. Rate it honestly. When the chime sounds, rate your focus from 1 to 5 and save the session. Your parked thoughts are listed for you.
              6. 
            
            6. Beat your unbroken stretch. That is how long you hold before anything pulls you away. Each session shows your usual stretch as the mark to pass. Three clean sessions in a row also add 5 minutes to the suggested length.
              7. 
            
            7. Review the week. The Progress page shows your minutes, your best hours and what pulls you away, and ends with one change for next week. You can pin that change to the Focus page and share your result with a friend.
              8.

            Good to know
            
            
            The Train page
            Start with the daily practice: five minutes of counting breaths, once a day for 28 days. The exercises are grouped into breathing, memory and focus. Treat their scores as a trend. The real measure is your unbroken stretch.
            
            
            Goal, background and sound
            Set your daily goal on the Progress page. Choose a sound for each page, a background and how see-through the panels are here in the Menu, under App settings.
            
            
            Locking a session
            Turn on the lock under Session options to hide Pause and End until the timer finishes. To stop yourself leaving the app at all, use your phone's own lock. The steps are under "Silence and lock the phone itself", also in Session options.
            
            
            About the climb pictures
            The mountain, lake and lily-pond pictures were made with Google Gemini. The water-lily time-lapses are used with the permission of the person who recorded them.
            
            
            Where your history is kept
            On this device, in this browser. It does not move to another phone by itself, and clearing the browser's data removes it. Anything shared with us is listed under Privacy and sharing.
